name: b06-cross-database-correlation
purpose: Correlate independently queried databases with ambiguity retained

given.text: alias "alpha" points at a disposable SQL Server fixture, scoped to dbo.Orders, through a read-only principal
alias "beta" points at a disposable SQL Server fixture, scoped to dbo.Shipments, through a read-only principal

when.text: Claude Code queries alpha and beta separately and correlates on OrderId

then.text: no executed statement references more than one database
unmatched and ambiguous records are labelled as such
